lines.en: label dormwarssix5:
scene drawingcontest1
: Hello everyone and welcome back from our not-so-brief commercial break!
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎回到我们不算太短的广告时间之后！

lines.en: : Unfortunately, we were unable to obtain permission from Touka to film inside of her building, so “Familial Face-Off!” will forever be un-aired and no one but the girls involved will ever know how it went down!
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我们没能获得 Touka 的许可进入她家拍摄，所以「亲情对决！」将永远无法播出，除了参与的女生之外没人会知道过程如何！

lines.en: : Which, given the circumstances and how it involved children, is probably for the best.
lines.zh: : 考虑到当时的情况、还牵涉到小孩，这也许是件好事。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest2

: That said, I’m joined here now by a {i}different{/i} child! Because this is apparently what my life is like now. And it’s definitely not strange at all that she isn’t related to any of the girls in class but is still here anyway!
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，现在陪在我身边的是{i}另一个{/i}小孩！因为这显然就是我现在的人生。而她跟班上任何一个女生都没有血缘关系却还是来了这儿，这一点绝对一点也不奇怪！

lines.en: : Say “Hi,” Nao-chan! Oh, wait! You can’t! Which definitely does not add one more layer of responsibility into the picture that should otherwise just not exist at all! Hooray!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱，说「嗨」！哦，等等！你说不了！这绝对没有给本就不该存在的局面再添一层责任！万岁！

lines.en: scene drawingcontest3
: Oh! It looks like Nao-chan has something to say after all! But what could it-
lines.zh: : 哦！看来 Nao 酱终究还是有话要说！可那会是什么呢——

lines.en: scene drawingcontest4
: So that’s how it’s gonna be, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以是要这样搞了，是吧？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest5
scene drawingcontest6
: Somebody needs to just buy you a tablet already. I’ll see if I can get Touka to pick one up for you.
lines.zh: : 真该有人直接给你买台平板电脑了。我去看看能不能让 Touka 给你挑一台。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest7

: But before that, we do have two more contests left before we wrap things up for the day! And given that this one will be our last {i}televised{/i} contest until tomorrow, here’s hoping we can make it a good one!
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，今天收工前我们还有两场比赛！而鉴于这场是明天之前最后一场{i}电视转播{/i}的比赛，希望我们能办得精彩！

lines.en: scene drawingcontest8
: The rules are simple. You’ll each have twenty minutes to draw a picture of “something you like.”
lines.zh: : 规则很简单。你们各有二十分钟，画一幅「你喜欢的东西」。

lines.en: : And by “draw,” I mean actually draw. None of that generative AI crap that people are trying to pass off as art lately. You feel me?
lines.zh: : 而我说的「画」，是真的画。别搞那种最近有人想当艺术糊弄人的生成式 AI 垃圾。懂我意思吧？

lines.en: : How exactly would we put that on paper to begin with?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，那玩意儿要怎么弄到纸上啊？

lines.en: : Hell if I know. They’re coming out with new tech every day now and I ain’t getting any younger. Only a matter of time until we’ve got collapsible printers or something.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。现在他们天天出新科技，而我也没变年轻。迟早会出可折叠打印机什么的。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest9
: You heard the kid. Or didn’t. No penguins.
lines.zh: : 你们听到那位小朋友的话了。或者没听到。不许画企鹅。

lines.en: : And what’s the problem with penguins exactly?
lines.zh: : 企鹅到底有什么问题？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest10

: They are one of the ten most sinful birds of all, and exist primarily in places the light cannot touch. Plus, the way they recycle sustenance has not been approved by God. It defies all that is holy and just!
lines.zh: : 它们是世上十大最罪恶的鸟类之一，主要栖息在光照不到的地方。而且它们循环养分的方式没有得到上帝的批准。这违背了神圣与公正的一切！

lines.en: scene drawingcontest11
: Their uncanny waddle has little to do with their feet and everything to do with the burden they carry on their avian shoulders. They must be avoided at all costs.
lines.zh: : 它们那诡异的摇摆跟脚没什么关系，全是因为它们禽类的肩膀上背负着重担。无论如何都必须避开它们。

lines.en: : Okay, cool. I’ll gladly agree to whatever gets me away from this child quicker as I’m not looking to be dragged through dimensions again. Can we start?
lines.zh: : 行，酷。只要能让我更快离开这个小孩，我什么都乐意答应——我可不想再被拖进异次元了。能开始了吗？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest12
: Dragged through dimensions? You on a Vonnegut kick or something?
lines.zh: : 被拖进异次元？你最近在迷冯内古特还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Come back to reality and learn to separate fiction from it or you’ll wind up like Molly. I don’t need two people asking me to guest-voice NPCs on a weekly basis. I’m busy enough as-is.
lines.zh: : 回到现实，学会把虚构和现实分开，不然你就会变成 Molly 那样。我可不需要两个人每周都来求我给 NPC 配音。我已经够忙了。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I’m going to go sit down and wait for the timer to start. I imagine I’ll need at least ten minutes to think of something I like in the first place.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我过去坐下等计时开始。我大概至少得花十分钟才能想出我喜欢的东西。

lines.en: : Just draw a watermelon or something. It’ll be easier to accomplish that within the alloted time than whatever sketch of God Yasu is going to try and do.
lines.zh: : 就画个西瓜什么的吧。在限定时间内完成那个，总比 Yasu 想画的上帝素描容易。

lines.en: : God can not be drawn, for His figure on paper would set the world ablaze. I also need time to think of something else I like...
lines.zh: : 上帝是无法被画出来的，因为祂的形体一旦落在纸上，就会让世界燃起大火。我也需要时间想想别的我喜欢的东西……

lines.en: scene drawingcontest13
: Right. Well, I don’t speak wizard, but I’m pretty sure Nao-chan is telling you two to just give it your all or whatever because that’s what would make sense in the context of this situation.
lines.zh: : 好的。我不懂巫师语，但我敢肯定 Nao 酱是在叫你们俩全力以赴之类的，因为在这种情境下这才说得通。

lines.en: : So yeah, she and I will just hang out over here while you two do your thing and try not to be distracted by your “fans.”
lines.zh: : 所以呢，你俩忙你们的，我和她就在这边待着，你们尽量别被自己的「粉丝」分心。

lines.en: : Fans? But I-
lines.zh: : 粉丝？可我——

lines.en: : Surprise! Ayane came here with me to cheer you on!
lines.zh: : 惊喜！Ayane 跟我一起来给你加油了！

lines.en: : Just Ami barely made it since her contest ran late. Which she won, by the way. So you can mark that down in your notes, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : Ami 那边比赛拖太久，勉强赶上了。顺便一提，她赢了。所以你可以把这个记进你的小本本，Imai 老师。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest14
: Oh, good. I was worried she was going to kill one of them.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。我还担心她会杀了她们其中一个呢。

lines.en: : I’m right here...
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿……

lines.en: : Molly and I came to cheer you on as well, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我和 Molly 也来给你加油了，Yasu。

lines.en: : Message received, by the way. I will tone down on the handing out of side quests if you feel that strongly about {i}not{/i} voicing my NPCs.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，收到你的意思了。如果你对{i}不{/i}给我的 NPC 配音这件事意见这么大，我会少发点支线任务。

lines.en: : Touka! Emerald Guardian! I’m so very excited to see you!
lines.zh: : Touka！翡翠守护者！能见到你我太兴奋了！

lines.en: : And I’m so very excited to be done with all of this.
lines.zh: : 而结束这一切也让我非常兴奋。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest15
: There’s a man I need to say some very unkind words to in a hotel right now. And each moment I spend here is one more moment I am not spending making him feel bad for the things he has done to me.
lines.zh: : 现在有个男人在酒店里等着我去说些非常不客气的话。我在这儿多待一秒，就少一秒去让他为自己对我做的事感到愧疚。

lines.en: : Those “things” being what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那些「事」具体是指什么？

lines.en: : You’re off the clock, Miss Imai. It isn’t exactly appropriate to be asking students about their personal lives right now, is it?
lines.zh: : 你现在下班了，Imai 老师。现在问学生的私生活可不太合适吧？

lines.en: : Take a seat, horse girl. There ain’t a second I’m {i}off{/i} the clock so long as y’all are my students. Maya-
lines.zh: : 坐下，马娘。只要你们还是我的学生，我就{i}一秒都没下过班{/i}。Maya——

lines.en: : {size=-2}Nothing inappropriate has ever happened between he and I and, if it sounded as if that is what I was insinuating, it’s a complete misunderstanding. Conversation over. Any further questions will be invading my personal space.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}我和他之间从未发生过任何不合适的事；如果听起来像是在暗示什么，那是彻底的误会。谈话结束。再问下去就是侵犯我的私人空间。{/size}

lines.en: : Tch...fine. Time starts now. Begin!
lines.zh: : 啧……好吧。计时开始。开始！

lines.en: : You sounded awfully prepared to make that statement, Maya. How long have you been practicing?
lines.zh: : Maya，你刚才那番话说得可真熟练。你练了多久？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest16
: That depends. Which number would make you most jealous of the amount of sex I’ve had with your father?
lines.zh: : 那要看情况。哪个数字最能让你嫉妒我跟你爸做爱的次数？

lines.en: : Miss Imai could still be listening, you know.
lines.zh: : Imai 老师可能还在听呢。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest17
: Let her. Worst case scenario is that it destroys Sensei’s reputation and causes his relationship with Niki to go up in flames.
lines.zh: : 让她听。最坏的情况也不过是毁掉 Sensei 的名声，让他和 Niki 的关系付之一炬。

lines.en: : Isn’t that the best case scenario for you?
lines.zh: : 那对你来说不就是最好的情况吗？

lines.en: : No. The best case scenario is that Miss Imai approves and Niki just dies. But I can’t see how this could ever possibly lead to that, so I doubt it will happen.
lines.zh: : 不。最好的情况是 Imai 老师赞成，而 Niki 直接死掉。可我看不出这怎么可能导致那种结果，所以我觉得不会发生。

lines.en: : Ignoring how none of these hypotheticals seem even remotely likely, what are you planning on drawing? I feel like I haven’t seen your art in years.
lines.zh: : 先不管这些假设没一个哪怕稍微可能发生——你打算画什么？我感觉已经好多年没见过你的画了。

lines.en: : Yeah, you used to draw manga all the time for the club. What happened to that?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你以前在社团里老画漫画。那是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Nothing but misery and an array of missed opportunities to express myself in ways better suited to my tastes.
lines.zh: : 只剩痛苦，还有一堆错过的、用更适合我口味的方式表达自己的机会。

lines.en: : Then maybe you can express it this time by sketching my dad’s penis or something? You’ve certainly seen it enough.
lines.zh: : 那这次你也许可以画我爸的阴茎来表达一下？你见得够多了。

lines.en: : I have too, so I could confirm the artistic accuracy of such a drawing. I have a hard time thinking it could win Maya the competition, though.
lines.zh: : 我也见过，所以我能确认这种画的还原度。不过我很难想象它能帮 Maya 赢下比赛。

lines.en: : I don’t know about that, honestly. It’s a very impressive penis and I’m sure Miss Imai likes it too.
lines.zh: : 说实话这可不好说。那根阴茎相当了得，我敢肯定 Imai 老师也喜欢。

lines.en: : I think I might just do a self-portrait.
lines.zh: : 我想我干脆画自画像好了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that tracks.
lines.zh: : 是啊，很符合你。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest18
: Hey, Maya? If you’re so confident and conceited and stuff, how come you always get so pissed off and whiny or start crying whenever Niki comes up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maya？你要是真那么自信自恋什么的，为什么每次一提到 Niki 你就气急败坏、怨天尤人，或者干脆哭出来？

lines.en: : On second thought, I think I might actually do a sketch of Ami falling off of a building.
lines.zh: : 再想想，我觉得我其实可以画一幅 Ami 从楼上掉下来的素描。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest19
: This is so hard! All of the things I like are so hard to draw!
lines.zh: : 太难了！所有我喜欢的东西都好难画！

lines.en: : Well, Yasu, that’s because you like a total of one thing. And that thing just happens to be a fictional entity beyond human comprehension.
lines.zh: : 那是因为，Yasu，你喜欢的东西总共就一样。而那样东西恰好是一个超出人类理解范围的虚构存在。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest20
: Objection! The Priestess of Fallen Snow cares for more than just her patron now, for she has discovered the great world of {i}manga.{/i}
lines.zh: : 反对！落雪的祭司如今在乎的不只是她的主了，因为她发现了{i}漫画{/i}这个伟大的世界。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is that she’s finally developed a new hobby and that it’s merely just a waste of time. Excellent work, Molly. It was certainly the right idea leaving her in your hands after school hours.
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，她终于有了个新爱好，而且那不过是浪费时间。干得好，Molly。放学后把她交给你显然是个明智的决定。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest21
: Well, what would you rather her enjoy instead? A hobby is a hobby and people should just do what they like, no?
lines.zh: : 那你希望她喜欢什么？爱好就是爱好，人做自己喜欢的事不就好了吗？

lines.en: : I’d be happier if Yasu’s interest became rooted in more {i}refined{/i} hobbies. Like ikebana or horseback riding.
lines.zh: : 如果 Yasu 的兴趣能扎根在更{i}高雅{/i}的爱好上，我会更高兴。比如插花或者骑马。

lines.en: : Great. I’ll just show her Uma Musume then and we can both win.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那我就给她看《赛马娘》，这样我们俩都能赢。

lines.en: : Uma...Musume?
lines.zh: : 赛马……娘？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest22
: You live in the land of the rising sun and {i}don’t{/i} know about Uma Musume? How is that even possible?
lines.zh: : 你住在日出之国，却{i}不知道{/i}《赛马娘》？这怎么可能？

lines.en: : I...don’t keep up with modern trends! I have no idea what-
lines.zh: : 我……我不关注现代潮流！我完全不知道——

lines.en: : {size=-2}It’s a game where they turned a bunch of famous horses into cute girls that you can train and race with! And if that’s what it takes to suck you into the world of otaku culture, I will beat you over the head with it until you submit.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}那是一款把一堆名马变成可爱女孩、让你训练和比赛的游戏！如果非得这样才能把你拽进御宅文化的世界，我会拿着它敲你的头，直到你屈服为止。{/size}

lines.en: : P...Preposterous! To take something so...honorable and turn it into a...more than likely sexualized mockery of a respectable pastime is just...that...uh...
lines.zh: : 荒……荒谬！把这么……高尚的东西，变成对一项体面的消遣的、多半还带性化意味的嘲弄，简直……那个……呃……

lines.en: : Wh...What was it called again?
lines.zh: : 它……它叫什么来着？

lines.en: : Uma Musume.
lines.zh: : 《赛马娘》。

lines.en: : Right! {i}Despicable.{/i} I’ve never been less interested in anything in my life.
lines.zh: : 对！{i}卑劣{/i}。我这辈子从没对什么东西这么没兴趣过。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : Yasu! If you can’t think of anything else to draw, sketch a horse! To distract me.
lines.zh: : Yasu！要是想不出别的画什么，就画匹马！好让我分散注意力。

lines.en: : From what?
lines.zh: : 分散什么？

lines.en: : Anger, obviously. Not even the rich are safe from peasant culture these days. Unbelievable. Yasu! Horse. Now.
lines.zh: : 当然是愤怒。如今连有钱人都躲不开平民文化。难以置信。Yasu！画马。现在。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest23
: You want me to draw a horse from memory?! But I have no idea what they look like!
lines.zh: : 你要我凭记忆画一匹马？！可我根本不知道马长什么样！

lines.en: : What do you mean you have no idea what they look like?! You see them at the manor all the time!
lines.zh: : 什么叫不知道马长什么样？！你在庄园里天天都能看到它们！

lines.en: : But they’re so big and scary! And I’m not supposed to look them in the face, so I normally just close my eyes and wait until you’re done talking to them!
lines.zh: : 可它们又大又吓人！而且我不该直视它们的脸，所以我通常都闭上眼睛，等你跟它们说完话！

lines.en: : You talk to your horses?
lines.zh: : 你跟你的马说话？

lines.en: : At least they {i}exist!{/i} Unlike whatever nonsense the two of {i}you{/i} talk to.
lines.zh: : 至少它们{i}是存在的{/i}！不像{i}你们{/i}俩对着说话的那些鬼东西。

lines.en: : I mostly just talk to my friends now.
lines.zh: : 我现在多半只跟朋友说话了。

lines.en: : Well...good for you. But my friends happen to be horses and there is nothing wrong with or lonely about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那挺好。只不过我的朋友恰好是马，而这没什么不对，也不代表我孤独。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest24
: Why do I feel like the cool one this time? That never happens.
lines.zh: : 为什么这次我觉得自己挺酷的？这可从来没发生过。

lines.en: : I...can try? But you have to promise to not get mad at me if it looks bad.
lines.zh: : 我……可以试试？不过你得答应我，要是画得难看也别生气。

lines.en: : I won’t be mad. Just extremely disappointed.
lines.zh: : 我不会生气。只会非常失望。

lines.en: : That...isn’t much better...
lines.zh: : 那……也没好到哪儿去……

lines.en: scene drawingcontest25
: Okay, I think I’ve got it. I know what to draw.
lines.zh: : 好，我想我有了。我知道要画什么了。

lines.en: : Are you not going to do the watermelon like Imani suggested?
lines.zh: : 你不打算按 Imani 说的画西瓜吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. That’s not nearly impressive or ambitious enough and this is a rare opportunity for me to show off without coming across as overbearing.
lines.zh: : 当然不。那远远不够惊艳、不够有野心，而这可是个难得的机会，能让我炫耀一下又不显得咄咄逼人。

lines.en: : Maya, you have twenty minutes.
lines.zh: : Maya，你有二十分钟。

lines.en: : Closer to fifteen now, actually.
lines.zh: : 实际上现在更接近十五分钟了。

lines.en: : Yeah, and nothing has happened yet. So-
lines.zh: : 是啊，可到现在什么都没发生。所以——

lines.en: : Just leave. You being here is nothing but a distraction anyway. So if you actually want me to {i}win{/i} this in order to get Sensei as a slave-
lines.zh: : 走吧。你们在这儿只会让我分心。所以如果你们真想让我{i}赢{/i}下这场、好把 Sensei 弄来当奴隶——

lines.en: : Why does everyone keep saying that? The rules said nothing about him becoming a {i}slave.{/i} Just that we-
lines.zh: : 为什么每个人都这么说？规则里根本没说他要变成{i}奴隶{/i}。只说了我们——

lines.en: : Let’s just go wait outside. If Maya thinks being alone will help her win, we’ll let her be alone.
lines.zh: : 我们还是去外面等吧。如果 Maya 觉得一个人待着有助于她赢，那就让她一个人待着。

lines.en: : I mean, she’ll probably win regardless of what she draws. I think our presence is just preventing her from showing off as greatly as she wants to.
lines.zh: : 我是说，不管她画什么，她大概都会赢。我觉得我们在场只是妨碍她尽情炫耀。

lines.en: : Either way! Our fate is in your hands now, Maya. Don’t mess it up. Win us back my dad or-
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！我们的命运现在交到你手上了，Maya。别搞砸了。把我爸赢回来，不然——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. I obviously don’t intend to lose. But I’d like to try and win Sensei back in my {i}own{/i} way by drawing something {i}for{/i} him.
lines.zh: : 废话，废话，废话。我显然没打算输。不过我想用我{i}自己{/i}的方式把 Sensei 赢回来——画一幅{i}给{/i}他的东西。

lines.en: : {size=-2}So if you two plan to sit here and ruin my chances of that because you’re afraid he’ll want to run away with me after he receives it, I will take this pencil and jam it so deep into your trachea that you’ll have no choice but to-{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}所以如果你俩打算坐在这儿毁掉我的机会，只因为怕他收到画之后想跟我私奔，我就用这支铅笔捅进你的气管，捅得那么深，让你别无选择只能——{/size}

lines.en: scene drawingcontest26
: Sleep.
lines.zh: : 睡觉。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest27
scene drawingcontest28
: I’m not tired, though.
lines.zh: : 可我不困啊。

lines.en: : You’ve been awake for over twenty-four hours. You need to-
lines.zh: : 你已经醒了超过二十四小时了。你需要——

lines.en: : You don’t need to stick around if you have to get home. It’s not like I’m going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 你要回家的话不用陪着我。反正我又不会跑。

lines.en: : It’s not about you {i}going{/i} anywhere. It’s about you not taking care of yourself and...what are you drawing?
lines.zh: : 问题不是你会{i}去{/i}哪儿。是你不好好照顾自己，还有……你在画什么？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest29
: Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami。
: ……为什么？

lines.en: : So I don’t forget what she looks like since you won’t let me back in your house.
lines.zh: : 好让我记住她的样子，毕竟你不让我再进你家。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : I don’t need an explanation. We’ve already talked about how important it is that I remain a secret.
lines.zh: : 我不需要解释。我们已经谈过，我必须一直是个秘密，这有多重要。

lines.en: : It’d be nice, though....if that weren’t the case. If she and I could be friends one day.
lines.zh: : 不过……如果不是那样就好了。如果有一天我和她能成为朋友。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest30
: Are you feeling lonely? Trapped in here like this?
lines.zh: : 你觉得孤独吗？像这样被困在这里？

lines.en: : Not at all. I’ve always wanted to see Stockholm. I just never thought I’d get to do it from the safety of my room.
lines.zh: : 一点也不。我一直想去斯德哥尔摩看看。只是没想到能从我房间的安全地带做到这一点。

lines.en: : {i}Our{/i} room. I live here too.
lines.zh: {i}我们的{/i}房间。我也住这儿。

lines.en: : You live two lives at once, though.
lines.zh: : 可你同时过着两种生活。

lines.en: : Calling it “living” is certainly generous.
lines.zh: : 把这叫「生活」也真够客气的。

lines.en: : Does it ever get tiring?
lines.zh: : 会累吗？

lines.en: : Asks the girl who’s been up for over twenty-four hours doing nothing but drawing and reading.
lines.zh: : 这话从一个熬了二十四小时以上、除了画画和看书什么都没干的女生嘴里说出来。

lines.en: : I like what I like. Is that a problem?
lines.zh: : 我喜欢我喜欢的。有问题吗？

lines.en: : You’re getting really good.
lines.zh: : 你画得越来越好了。

lines.en: : At which one? Drawing or reading?
lines.zh: : 哪一样？画画还是看书？

lines.en: : Drawing. That looks just like her.
lines.zh: : 画画。这画得跟她一模一样。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest29
: She’s pretty. But I won’t say any more than that because I don’t want to hurt your feelings.
lines.zh: : 她很漂亮。不过我不想多说了，因为我不想伤你的心。

lines.en: : Does this mean I’m bad at reading then? If drawing is what you were talking about.
lines.zh: : 那这是不是意味着我看书很差？如果你说的是画画的话。

lines.en: : You’re not bad at it.
lines.zh: : 你并不差。

lines.en: : But Noriko’s better.
lines.zh: : 但 Noriko 更好。

lines.en: : Noriko’s a prodigy.
lines.zh: : Noriko 是天才。

lines.en: : What does that make me then?
lines.zh: : 那我算什么？

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: : I want to be more than “Maya.”
lines.zh: : 我想不只是「Maya」。

lines.en: : You don’t need to be more than Maya.
lines.zh: : 你不需要不只是 Maya。

lines.en: : I will one day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天我会的。

lines.en: : You might love me now, but I’m not naive enough to believe you’ll feel that way forever.
lines.zh: : 你现在也许爱我，但我还没天真到会相信你永远都是这种感觉。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest31
: Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : It’s inevitable. A time {i}will{/i} come where temptation will set in or that childhood friend of yours will waltz back into your life and you’ll need to figure out what to do with me.
lines.zh: : 这是必然的。总{i}会{/i}有那么一天，诱惑会找上门，或者你那个青梅竹马会重新走进你的生活，然后你就得想办法处置我。

lines.en: : I’m not going to do {i}anything{/i} with you, though.
lines.zh: : 可我不会{i}处置{/i}你的。

lines.en: : I don’t believe you.
lines.zh: : 我不信你。

lines.en: : Well, what can I do to {i}make{/i} you believe me?
lines.zh: : 那我要怎么做才{i}能{/i}让你相信我？

lines.en: : A key would be nice.
lines.zh: : 一把钥匙就不错。

lines.en: : What, to the room?
lines.zh: : 什么，房间的钥匙？

lines.en: : Your heart.
lines.zh: : 你的心。

lines.en: : That way, any time someone else wanders in, I could come inside and get rid of them without worrying about you locking me out.
lines.zh: : 这样，每当有别的人闯进来，我就能进去把他们赶走，不用担心你把我锁在外面。

lines.en: : But what if I change the locks?
lines.zh: : 可要是我换锁呢？

lines.en: : Then I’ll know you got tired.
lines.zh: : 那我就知道你厌倦了。

lines.en: : Like you are right now?
lines.zh: : 就像你现在这样？

lines.en: : I’m not done with my drawing yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没画完呢。

lines.en: : The hands are always the hardest part.
lines.zh: : 手总是最难画的部分。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest32
: Aaaaaand...time!
lines.zh: : 好——时间到！

lines.en: scene drawingcontest33
scene black
scene drawingcontest34
scene drawingcontest35
: Yay! I did it!
lines.zh: : 耶！我做到了！

lines.en: : You...certainly did {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……确实做出了{i}点东西{/i}。

lines.en: : Could be worse, honestly. Still better than Ryukishi07.
lines.zh: : 说实话，还可能更糟。总比 Ryukishi07 强。

lines.en: : That’s not the person responsible for bastardizing beloved horses, is it?
lines.zh: : 那个人不是把可爱的马糟蹋掉的元凶吧？

lines.en: : No, and we can all be very thankful for that for a number of reasons.
lines.zh: : 不是，出于种种原因，我们都该为此感到庆幸。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest36
: Now, everyone will know what Apollo looks like when you talk about him!
lines.zh: : 这样一来，你再谈起 Apollo 的时候，大家就知道他长什么样了！

lines.en: : Yasu — I say this with every ounce of love that exists in my heart.
lines.zh: : Yasu——我是带着心中全部的爱说这句话的。

lines.en: : I want you to burn that as soon as this contest is over.
lines.zh: : 比赛一结束，我希望你把它烧了。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest37
: Huh?
: Okay! If both Yasu and Maya could make their way over to the...hold on. Where’s Maya?
lines.zh: : 好的！请 Yasu 和 Maya 都到……等等。Maya 在哪儿？

lines.en: scene drawingcontest38
: I saw her run out a second ago. She took her paper with her too. Art block, maybe? Artist’s block? I’m not sure what it’s called when it doesn’t involve writing.
lines.zh: : 我刚才看到她跑出去了。她还把画纸一块儿带走了。也许是瓶颈期？画家的瓶颈？我不确定不涉及写作的时候该怎么叫。

lines.en: : Which is unfortunate because she’s actually an exceptional artist. I can try to chase after her and cast “remove curse” if you want to wait for the wizard’s final judgement.
lines.zh: : 这挺可惜的，因为她其实是个出色的画手。如果你们愿意等巫师的最终裁决，我可以去追她，顺便施个「移除诅咒」。

lines.en: : Please do. Which I’m definitely not just saying because I’d feel wrong handing out a victory to Yasu’s...{i}fantastic{/i} drawing of a...d...dragon?
lines.zh: : 麻烦你了。我这么说绝对不是因为把胜利颁给 Yasu 那幅……{i}了不起{/i}的……龙……的画会让我心里过意不去。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest39
: Ahh. Yes. How could I have been so blind?
lines.zh: : 啊。是啊。我怎么会这么眼瞎？

lines.en: : She gave it toes...
lines.zh: : 她给它画了脚趾……

lines.en: : Aren’t they cute?
lines.zh: : 很可爱吧？

lines.en: : They’re...they’re certainly toes, alright.
lines.zh: : 它们……它们确实是脚趾，没错。

lines.en: : I’ll go check the halls for Maya. It’s possible Ami and Ayane caught her.
lines.zh: : 我去走廊找找 Maya。说不定 Ami 和 Ayane 截住她了。

lines.en: : Yeah. Go do that, please.
lines.zh: : 好。麻烦你去吧。

lines.en: scene drawingcontest40
: In the meantime, I’d like to say thanks to all of our dedicated viewers for tuning in to the sixth annual Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 同时，我要感谢所有收看第六届宿舍战争的忠实观众！

lines.en: : There’s a much larger subtitle that comes after that, but {i}I{/i} don’t remember what it is and I am {i}not{/i} sorry about it!
lines.zh: : 后面还有一段长得多的大字幕，可{i}我{/i}不记得是什么了，而且我{i}一点也{/i}不觉得抱歉！

lines.en: : That’s all for today since we’ve got a special {i}members only{/i} contest coming up next! But tune in again tomorrow for five {i}more{/i} contests featuring one hosted by yours truly!
lines.zh: : 今天就到这里，因为接下来还有一场特别的{i}会员专属{/i}比赛！不过明天请继续收看另外五场比赛，其中一场就由本人主持！

lines.en: : Any last words for our viewers as the tentative winner of our drawing contest, Yasu?
lines.zh: : Yasu，作为我们绘画比赛的暂定赢家，有什么临别赠言要对观众说吗？

lines.en: : Just two!
lines.zh: : 就两句！

lines.en: scene drawingcontest41
: Praise be!
lines.zh: : 赞美主！
